events.title: House of Mantra
events.description: An evening of soulful Kirtans and Bhajans at The Yoga Barn, featuring the Ilahi Sufi Qawwali ensemble: Tahir Qawwal, Alexandra Amïe, Jamuna Luna, and Rāma on classical percussion. Qawwali is the ancient Sufi devotional tradition of heart-opening, trance-inducing sacred song — voices layered over tabla and harmonium until the room forgets its edges. Bhajans weave Hindu devotional melody into the same thread. Rare to hear this genre performed at this level in Ubud. The kind of evening that stills the nervous system and opens the chest.
events.short_description: Qawwali and Bhajan devotional music evening at The Yoga Barn with Tahir Qawwal and the Ilahi ensemble.

events.title: SuperMoon Conscious Party — Purnama at Akasha
events.description: Akasha New Earth Haven's monthly full-moon ceremony — held on the purnama itself. Opens at sunset with a sacred Vital Cacao Ceremony by fire, flows through ecstatic dance led by resident facilitator Karunika, and closes with sound healing under the stars. The eco-dome pavilion, organic gardens, and natural swimming pool at Akasha form one of Ubud's most immersive night settings for this kind of gathering. Alcohol-free. Arrive from 17:00.
events.short_description: Full-moon cacao ceremony, ecstatic dance, and sound healing at Akasha New Earth Haven on the July purnama.
